## Highlights

Building blocks for an admin screen that manages invitations, and one fix. There are no breaking changes. If you build your own admin screens, or use [ezauth-admin](https://github.com/josuebrunel/ezauth-admin), these are for you.

### New

- **Get the invitation link back.** `Auth.InvitationIssue` does what `InvitationCreate` does, but returns the accept link, and a mail failure is reported in `EmailErr` instead of failing the call. So an admin can still show or share the link when email isn't delivered. The link isn't JSON-encoded, so it can't end up in an API response by accident. See #223.
- **List every open invitation.** `Auth.InvitationsAll` lists the open invitations of all inviters, newest first, with paging. Expired ones are included so they can be re-issued, and accepted or revoked ones are not. `InvitationInfo` now has an `InviterID`. See #224.
- **Revoke any invitation.** `Auth.InvitationRevokeByID` revokes an invitation whoever sent it. `InvitationRevoke` keeps its ownership check. See #225.

None of these check authorization, like the other admin methods, so check the caller yourself.

### Changed

- **A failed send no longer leaves an open invitation.** When the email can't be sent, `InvitationCreate` used to return an error but leave a pending invitation nobody had the link to. It now revokes it first. Use `InvitationIssue` if you'd rather keep it.

### Upgrading

Nothing to do. There are no migrations in this release.
